intent.note: Task clause: 'make the skip conditional on the shell not being dash ... keep the old red for dash'. The diff adds return_trap_verdict(dash_present, left_count, honoured): left==1 -> control; no dash AND left==0 AND the fallback shell honours the trap when probed directly -> skip; everything else (above all dash on PATH with 0 left) -> check(..., False) naming count, dash presence and probe result. The skip text no longer tells a dash user to install dash. This deviates slightly from the suggested spelling (skip's absent is the direct probe plus no-dash, not len(left)==0 alone), which is stricter and consistent with skip()'s docstring.
